verdict.rationale: Issuing is described as API-first (comm-1, probe-2). The docs explicitly say disputes and funding details work through both the Dashboard and the API (docs-11, docs-9). Core operations are documented as API objects: card and cardholder creation, spending controls, and real-time authorization via webhook (docs-1, docs-3, docs-4, docs-5). missing for 10: an explicit statement of full Dashboard/API parity, API coverage for card-design customization and some other Dashboard workflows, a discoverable OpenAPI spec (probe 404s), and independent hands-on confirmation of parity.
